title: Apparel Return Window
text: Apparel items can generally be returned within 7 days of delivery when they are unused and have their original tags attached. Items that show signs of use, washing, or damage may be rejected during inspection.

title: Footwear Return Window
text: Footwear can generally be returned within 7 days of delivery when it is unused and returned with the original packaging. Shoes showing outdoor wear or damage may not qualify for return.

title: Electronics Return Window
text: Eligible electronics can generally be returned within 10 days of delivery for qualifying defects or issues covered by the product policy. Customers may be asked to complete troubleshooting or provide diagnostic information before a return is approved.

title: Home Products Return Window
text: Eligible home products can generally be returned within 7 days of delivery if they are unused and meet the applicable return conditions. Large or assembled items may have additional return restrictions.

title: COD Refund Timeline
text: For an eligible COD return, the refund is normally initiated after the returned item passes the required inspection. Once initiated, the refund may take several business days to reach the customer's selected refund method.

title: Prepaid Refund Timeline
text: For prepaid orders, an eligible refund is normally initiated after the returned item passes the required inspection. The time taken for the refund to appear can depend on the original payment method and banking network.

title: Standard Delivery SLA
text: Standard delivery dates depend on the seller, destination, inventory availability, and logistics route. The expected delivery date shown for the order is the primary estimate used for customer communication.

title: Delayed Delivery
text: If an order passes its expected delivery date, customers should check the latest tracking status before requesting further assistance. Logistics delays can occur because of weather, operational disruptions, or route constraints.

title: Reverse Pickup Eligibility
text: Reverse pickup is available for eligible return requests in serviceable locations. Pickup availability depends on the product, seller policy, return reason, and logistics coverage for the customer's address.

title: Self-Ship Return
text: If reverse pickup is unavailable for an eligible return, the customer may be offered a self-ship return option where supported. Instructions for packaging and shipping should be followed exactly to avoid delays in processing.

title: Return Inspection
text: Returned products can be inspected before the return is approved. Missing accessories, altered products, physical damage, or signs of use can affect return eligibility.

title: Damaged Product
text: Customers should report a product that arrives damaged as soon as possible through the applicable support or return workflow. Photos or other evidence may be requested to help determine the appropriate resolution.

title: Wrong Product Received
text: If a customer receives a product different from the item ordered, the issue should be reported through the return or support workflow. The order details and delivered product may be checked before a replacement or refund is approved.

title: Return Packaging
text: Customers should return eligible products with the original packaging and included accessories whenever required by the product policy. Incomplete packaging can affect inspection and return approval.

title: Cancellation Before Shipment
text: An order may generally be cancelled before it reaches the shipment stage when cancellation is available for that order. Once an order has entered certain shipping stages, cancellation may no longer be available.

title: Exchange Eligibility
text: Exchange availability depends on the product category, seller policy, inventory, and the reason for the exchange. If an exchange is unavailable, an eligible return and refund may be offered instead.
